question: Qual percentual de clientes recorrentes teve pelo menos um pedido entregue com atraso?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.is_delayed = TRUE THEN c.customer_unique_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS pct_repeat_with_delay 
FROM marts.dim_customers c 
JOIN marts.fct_orders o 
    ON c.customer_unique_id = o.customer_unique_id 
WHERE c.is_repeat_customer = TRUE 
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';
